:::note[About this page]
This page is generated from the `tools/list` response of [s1000d-writer-mcp](/s1000d-stack/mcp/writer-mcp/) 0.6.0. The s1000d-writer-mcp page explains the configuration and how to read the responses.
:::

## Summary

Starts an in-work issue of a released data module. `inWork` becomes `01`, `issueNumber` stays, and `issueType` is the value you give (`changed`, `revised` or `status`; the server does not choose it). The change markup and the reasons for update of the previous issue are removed, and elements marked `changeType="delete"` are taken out. The released issue is not changed: the in-work issue is written as a new file. If you pass `reason`, one reason for update is added in the same call

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Start an in-work issue of a RELEASED data module (issueInfo/@inWork "00") so that it can be changed by the S1000D rules. The result is a NEW document: issueNumber unchanged, inWork "01", issueType as given; the released issue is never changed. The change markup of the previous issue is removed (changeType / changeMark / reasonForUpdateRefIds, changeInline tags with their text kept, every reasonForUpdate) and elements marked changeType="delete" are removed; only those ranges of the original text are rewritten. issueType is REQUIRED and is the user's decision: "changed" (changes shown with change markup: then edit with edit_data_module marking), "revised" (reworked, no change markup), "status" (only the identification and status section), "new" only when starting from issue 001-00. Optional "reason" adds one reasonForUpdate to the in-work issue in the same call (with revised or status from issue 002 on, the default BREX requires one). Refused: a document already in work, a deleted issue, an id of a removed element that the rest still refers to. Not done: release (inWork back to "00", issueNumber + 1), issueDate, quality assurance. Returns started, xml (unless includeXml is false), previous, issueInfo, issueType, fileName, removed{}, reasonForUpdate, refusals[], newSchemaErrors[], referencedFromOtherObjects[], verification, fixes[]. With write: true the in-work issue is written under fileName beside "path" (or into the CSDB when xml was given); an existing file of that name is a write-conflict.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the document. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders used to resolve references, find BREX and number new objects (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `issueType` | `string` | Yes | `changed` / `revised` / `status` / `new` | issueType of the in-work issue. Ask the user; it is never chosen for you. "new" is accepted only when starting from 001-00 (it follows Chap 3.9.5.1 Table 3 but the default BREX reports BREX-S1-00030). |
| `reason` | `object` |  |  | Optional: one reason for update to add to the in-work issue (same as add_reason_for_update). If it cannot be added, the in-work issue is not started either. |
| `reason.text` | `string` | Yes | length ≥ 1 | The text of the reason (one simplePara). |
| `reason.updateReasonType` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^urt[0-9]{2}$` | S1000D updateReasonType, written as given: urt01 editorial change (no change markup may refer to it), urt02 technical change, urt03 markup only, urt04 applicability only, urt05 references only; urt51-urt99 are project values. Required: it is never chosen for you. |
| `reason.updateHighlight` | `string` |  | `0` / `1` | "1": this reason goes into the Highlights data module. |
| `reason.id` | `string` |  |  | reasonForUpdate/@id. Omit it: an id that is not in the document is made (rfu-0001 …). An id already in the document is refused. |
| `product` | `object` |  |  | The product to evaluate applicability for. attributes: ACT productAttribute id → value; conditions: CCT cond id → value. Omit to skip the applicability check. |
| `product.attributes` | `object` |  |  |  |
| `product.conditions` | `object` |  |  |  |
| `write` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true. |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, replace a file of the same name. Default false: an existing file is left alone and reported as write-conflict. |
| `allowInvalid` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, write even when verification.schema.state is "invalid". Default false. |
| `includeXml` | `boolean` |  |  | Include the XML in the response (default: true when write is false, false when write is true). |
| `maxFixes` | `integer` |  | default `50`, ≥ 1, ≤ 1000 | Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50). |
